entities.name: Hanweir
entities.description: Agricultural village in Videns Parish, Gavony, consumed by Emrakul's influence and fused into a single Eldrazi ooze.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi Titan whose influence transformed Hanweir.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Archangel whose madness raised tensions in Videns Parish.

entities.name: Oliver Hayfield
entities.description: Editor-in-chief of The Hanweir Chronicle who documented the village's paranoia.

entities.name: Moiren
entities.description: Cathar who with two dozen others slew the Town after the Travails.

events.summary: Hanweir declares independence from Videns Parish and Gavony and walls itself in with no gate.
events.quote: the village declared independence from both Videns Parish and Gavony province

events.summary: Under Emrakul's influence, women give birth only to twins and the council forbids anyone leaving.
events.quote: women in Hanweir began giving birth only to twins

events.summary: The citizens and town fuse into a single Eldrazi ooze that spreads across Videns Parish.
events.quote: fused body and soul into a single protoplasmic mass

events.summary: Moiren and two dozen cathars slay the Town after the Travails.
events.quote: was slain by Moiren and a group of two dozen other cathars

relations.quote: thriving agricultural village in Videns Parish
was slain by Moiren and a group of two dozen other cathars
